initial_conditions: Harbor revision 23, two original pieces, eight seams and distinct output paths.
actions: Open the saved Harbor construction and use File > Export GLB.
Take one Manual step and export the current surface through Command search.
Check both outputs with Khronos Validator and compare the independent OBJ parse and native project.
expected_outcomes: Two named surfaces, 654 vertices, 1172 triangles, unchanged authoring bytes, and zero Khronos errors and warnings per file; index equality and OBJ position agreement within 1e-6 m.
